steps.name: Phase 0 — Spec & plan (await sign-off)
steps.description: Write spec.md and plan.md (v5.5) for the BrassClaw design transition. v5.5 builds on v5 (class codes 00-21+50, trust removal, PlanA-memory as universal retrieval connector, prompt-composition ordering, validation split, component tag system §3.9, Monty VM settings §3.10, 4-queue validation lifecycle §3.5.1, 9 new class codes 12-20, Actions class §3.11, unified intent system §3.12, intent-driven retrieval §3.13, token-budget prior-knowledge limit, "try it with AI" fallback, orchestrator formatting ban §3.14, DB-less fallback file §3.4, "AI before User" flip switch, Monty VM kernel-owned restart) PLUS v5.5 ADDITIONS: (1) VALIDATOR INDEPENDENCE (§3.5); (2) LLM CODE-AUDIT FOR ORCHESTRATOR (10) + SCAFFOLD (50) (§3.5); (3) SELF-IMPROVEMENT MISSION WRITES REROUTED (§3.6); (4) FORMATTING DESIGN Q19 RESOLVED — "content is king" + Solution Override (§3.13/§3.14); (5) PHASE 1.5 UNBLOCKED. ALL 19 OPEN QUESTIONS (Q1-Q19) RESOLVED. v5.5 COMPREHENSIVE REVIEW COMPLETE: 4 parallel subagents (codebase verification, security, correctness, performance) verified 29 codebase claims (26/29 confirmed), identified 12 security issues, 13 correctness issues, 19 performance issues. ALL BLOCKING fixed (Scaffold 11→50, Actions schema body jsonb→separate columns, migration renumbering V34-V50, stale format_action→Solution Override, ToolSkill dedicated table). ALL CRITICAL/HIGH mitigated in §6.1: SEC-08 spawn_subprocess sandbox (host runtime script lane, NOT raw Popen), SEC-01 by-ID validation gate, SEC-02 validation_config safety floors, SEC-05 score bounding (cap 100, rate limit 50/hr, learned_llm flagged), SEC-07 allowed_tools defense in depth (Python+Rust), SEC-04 rollback CAS, SEC-09 recursion bounding (depth 5, cycle detection, step budget 1000), SEC-10 DB-less profile check, SEC-11 Q4 wipe transaction, PERF-05 reborn_component_catalog read model, PERF-16 Monty restart drain+admission control, PERF-18 Action hard limits (256KB/500 steps/50 tools), PERF-04 normalized schema, PERF-03 atomic score increment, PERF-02 single CASE query, PERF-01 B-tree exact match. ALL MAJOR/MEDIUM mitigated: FMT-02 budget algorithm defined, INT-01 disambiguation 30s timeout, SEC-06 user_preferences scope clarified, PERF-06 LIMIT 50, PERF-07 re-sort by class_code, CC-03 Phase 0 desc 00-21+50, SCH-02 extensions PKC columns, PH-02 trust stub semantics, PH-03 extract_keywords Rust not deleted. ALL 19 open questions resolved — Phase 0 ready for sign-off. Artifacts in .zenflow/tasks/i-want-you-to-make-a-plan-to-fun-80d7/.

steps.name: Phase 1 — DB-stored Skills + Intent system + Actions class (default.py executor)
steps.description: Move Skills from SKILL.md into reborn_skills with agentskills.io schema, EXPLICIT columns, 3-class in compatibility, class_code+prompt_uid, consumer_tags[], NO trust column (trust stub returns Trusted for all — PH-02 fix, deleted in Phase 3), intent_examples jsonb. ADD unified intent system (§3.12): reborn_intent_inputs table — NORMALIZED SCHEMA (PERF-04: one row per (scope, input_text, input_class, component_id), NOT uuid[] array), score hard cap 100 (SEC-05), rate limit 50/scope/hr (SEC-05), learned_llm flagged needs_review (SEC-05), B-tree exact-match index (PERF-01), single CASE query for match-order (PERF-02), atomic UPDATE...RETURNING score increment (PERF-03), __resolve_intent__ host function with query classification (4 classes + ? rule), match-order a-c, scoring d-f with disambiguation special chat message type (30s timeout — INT-01), no-match e-f, "try it with AI" fallback (Q12 — entirely Rust-side: orchestrator passes fallback: true flag, Rust runs extract_keywords + class-4 keyword matching + component fetch + prompt assembly without re-entering Python), "AI before User" flip switch (Q18 — ON: silent keyword fallback; OFF: default; per-user in reborn_user_preferences — SEC-06: user-level scope, not component-level), disambiguation UX, learning-on-match; validator extracts intent_examples on validation. ADD Actions class (§3.11, Q13 — 13 step types): reborn_actions table (class_code=16) with 13 step descriptors, NO separate Rust ActionExecutor — default.py IS the executor, orchestrator dispatch (intent match → RetrievalEngine pulls Action → prior knowledge created → default.py performs Action, no __llm_complete__ call), allowed_tools[] enforcement DEFENSE IN DEPTH (SEC-07: BOTH default.py AND Rust EffectExecutor), timeout_secs bounding, Actions EXEMPT from prior_knowledge_token_budget truncation, Actions do NOT conform to skill size limits, HARD LIMITS (PERF-18: max 256KB content, max 500 steps, max 50 allowed_tools — rejected at validation), RECURSION BOUNDING (SEC-09: call_action max depth 5, cycle detection, total step budget 1000), SPAWN_SUBPROCESS SANDBOX (SEC-08: host runtime script lane, NOT raw Popen, allowed_tools must include spawn_subprocess, command/args/cwd validated against allowlist), step vocabulary is Python tunable logic. Steps 1.1-1.4 (schema, store, split SKILL.md + extract intent examples, prompt assembler); Step 1.5 (intent system: V35 migration with normalized schema + B-tree + GIN trigram, intent_system.rs, __resolve_intent__, query classifier, match-order single CASE query, scoring with disambiguation 30s timeout, no-match, "try it with AI" fallback entirely Rust-side, "AI before User" flip switch, learning seed on validation); Step 1.6 (Actions: V36 migration with separate preconditions/steps/error_handling columns, NO action_executor.rs, default.py Action-execution mode with 13 step types, orchestrator dispatch flow). Verify: cargo test -p brassclaw_skills -p brassclaw_pg; prompt-ordering byte-identity; consumer-tag CHECK; 05:validator exclusion; intent system (4 classes + ? rule, single CASE query, atomic score increment, score cap 100, rate limit, match-order a-c, scoring d-f with disambiguation 30s timeout, no-match e-f, "try it with AI" fallback entirely Rust-side, "AI before User" flip switch, disambiguation, learning, B-tree + GIN trigram, normalized schema); Actions (all 13 step types, allowed_tools defense in depth, timeout, orchestrator dispatch intent match→no LLM call, call_action chaining with depth 5 + cycle detection + step budget 1000, try_catch error recovery, parallel concurrency, spawn_subprocess sandbox via host runtime script lane, wait polling, emit_event to brassclaw_events event bus, token-budget exemption, hard limits 256KB/500 steps/50 tools, intent examples).

steps.name: Phase 1.5 (UNBLOCKED) — Prompt-path dedup + Q19 resolved formatting + self-modification boundary
steps.description: UNBLOCKED (spec §7 Q1 + Q19 resolved). Resolve v1→v2 duplications (context.rs dead path, score_skill/signals_tool_intent Rust+Python twins, format_docs/format_skills/append_system_append Python formatters) and define the self-modification boundary. Design decisions confirmed: (a) build_step_context is RESURRECTED (Option A: User-msg injection at N-1); (b) Python score_skill/signals_tool_intent + all 8 intent-detection functions (§2.3a) are DELETED entirely — the intent system (§3.12) replaces them; (c) FORMATTING DEDUP (Q19 RESOLVED — "content is king" + Solution Override): format_docs/format_skills/append_system_append DELETED from Python (orchestrator formatting ban §3.14); format_output/_reduce_prompt/compact_if_needed KEPT in Python. Rust formatting approach is RESOLVED: one __assemble_prior_knowledge__ function + a static class-code→label lookup table. No per-class Rust formatters. Components store content as the exact prior-knowledge text; Rust concatenates in (class_code asc, prompt_uid asc) order with per-item headers (### [{class_code}:{CLASS-LABEL}] {name}). Solution-class components (Extensions/Plans/Recipes/Actions) have prior_knowledge_content TEXT NULL + override_prompt_creation BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false (Actions default true) for the Solution Override path (PKC/content IS the complete prompt, no headers, orchestrator skips LLM call for Actions); (d) ORCHESTRATOR FORMATTING BAN (§3.14): orchestrator cannot format/mutate System prefix/choose injection point; CAN decide WHEN to retrieve/compact/reduce + honor "AI before User" flip switch + honor Solution Override; (e) VALIDATOR INDEPENDENCE (§3.5): the Step-1 validator is Rust-side infrastructure NOT part of default.py — the self-improvement mission cannot patch it. All self-improvement mission writes are validation-gated (§3.6): memory_write for code/component changes creates update-candidates that enter Q1. Orchestrator (10) + Scaffold (50) components require an LLM code-audit (kohai-provider, Rust-side-constructed prompt, checks for self-modification looping security issues) before Q2 manual validation — the Q2 "Validate" button is disabled until the LLM audit returns clean. The 3-failure auto-rollback (load_orchestrator) is retained as a safety net behind the validation gate; (f) __RESOLVE_INTENT__ DB-LESS FALLBACK (§3.4): in DB-less mode the intent system is OVERRIDDEN — __resolve_intent__ returns {db_less_fallback: true}; orchestrator falls back to keyword-retrieval path against the DB-less fallback-content file loaded by RamSource (Step 5.1b); "try it with AI" + "AI before User" NOT available in DB-less mode. Remaining work: implement User-message-at-N-1 injection path (resurrect build_step_context as Rust-side User-message insertion); delete 8 intent-detection functions from default.py; delete format_docs/format_skills/append_system_append from default.py; reroute memory_write for code/component changes through __validate_component__; implement LLM code-audit gate for Orchestrator (10) + Scaffold (50) at Q1→Q2. No stop-after — proceed to Phase 2.

steps.name: Phase 3 — Remove source-driven security + 4-queue validation lifecycle (validator-tag greyed-out mechanism)
steps.description: Remove SkillTrust + source-driven trust + skill-trust attenuation; two-step validation becomes the ONLY gate (Validated == trusted + no 05:validator consumer tag). Expand validator to validate code. Formalize the 4-queue validation lifecycle (Q1 auto / Q2 manual-WebUI / Q3 revision / Q4 rejection+wipe) with the validator-tag (05:validator) greyed-out mechanism. Steps: (3.1) delete SkillTrust enum, V2SkillMetadata.trust, default_trust(), trust-by-source-directory in registry.rs, skill-trust attenuation, Installed/Trusted tool-access distinction; (3.2) source becomes pure provenance — confidence factor kept as fallback-only routing signal (Q2); (3.3) audit all loop filters — Validated-only + consumer_tags[] NOT CONTAINS 05:validator is the sole gate; (3.4) VALIDATOR INDEPENDENCE (§3.5): expand validator to validate orchestrator Python + Monty-class extension payloads + Actions step descriptors. The Step-1 validator is Rust-side infrastructure NOT part of default.py. LLM CODE-AUDIT for Orchestrator (10) + Scaffold (50) at Q1→Q2 transition. Self-improvement mission writes rerouted through __validate_component__; (3.5) validator-tag greyed-out mechanism + 4 queues (Q1 auto, Q2 manual-WebUI with generalized routes for all ~20 class codes, Q3 revision via scheduled Extension, Q4 rejection+wipe with q4_retention_days). **SEC-11 §6.1:** Q4 wipe is a SINGLE TRANSACTION (component + intent_inputs + reliability + provenance atomically deleted — BEGIN...COMMIT; concurrent turn reads committed rows only via READ COMMITTED isolation); (3.6) PER-CLASS VALIDATION CONFIGURATION (Q14 RESOLVED — §3.5.2): only Skills (classes 01-03) require full agentskills.io validation; all other classes use lighter validation. reborn_validation_config table (V38__reborn_validation_config.sql — one row per (scope, class_code) with name_min_len/name_max_len/name_pattern/description_min_len/description_max_len/token_budget/token_budget_hard_error/require_tool_name/require_param_schema/require_activation_criteria). **SEC-02 §6.1 — compiled-in safety floors:** validation config changes are immediate-write BUT CANNOT loosen below compiled-in safety floors. ComponentValidator enforces minimums regardless of config row: token_budget cannot exceed compiled-in hard cap (Skills ≤5000, Orchestrator ≤50000), require_tool_name/require_param_schema cannot be false for Tools (class 00), require_activation_criteria cannot be false for Skills (01-03). WebUI Validation Config panel shows floor as disabled minimum and prevents saving below it. Config row violating floor rejected at save time with clear error. Defaults per class: Skills 5000 hard + activation criteria; Tools 5000 hard + tool_name + param_schema; Extensions 10000 soft; Actions no token budget; former doctypes 10000 soft (Notes 2000); Recipes 10000 soft + trigger validation; Orchestrator/Scaffold 50000 soft + LLM audit. Validator renamed ComponentValidator (from RecipeValidator) with validate_by_class(class_code, component, config_row, ...) dispatch — existing validate_tool_skill/validate_recipe become Skills/Recipes branches, other classes get lightweight validate_generic. WebUI Validation tab gets "Validation Config" sub-panel showing each class code with editable thresholds (Phase 6). Changes are immediate-write but do not retroactively re-validate existing components. **SEC-04 §6.1 — rollback CAS protection:** orchestrator rollback uses compare-and-swap on reborn_orchestrators.active — WHERE id=? AND failure_count=? (failure count at detection time) prevents concurrent turn from racing the rollback; concurrent turns during rollback admitted but immediately fail with OrchestratorRollbackInProgress (no partial execution). **SEC-05 §6.1:** score increments bounded (hard cap 100, rate limit 50/scope/hour token bucket), learned_llm inputs flagged needs_review:true and purged on source component wipe. Verify: cargo test -p brassclaw_skills; recipe_library contract; is_valid_transition guard; is_queue_status for all 4 queues; confidence-factor source-independence; fallback routing test; validator-tag pop; update-candidate tag inheritance; Q1→Q2→Q3→Q4 lifecycle; **Q4 wipe test (SEC-11: single transaction — component + intent_inputs + reliability + provenance deleted atomically)**; generalized route test; code-validation gate; validator independence; LLM code-audit gate; self-improvement memory_write reroute; PER-CLASS VALIDATION CONFIG TEST (ComponentValidator::validate_by_class dispatch for each class code: Skills full agentskills.io, Tools tool_name+param_schema, Extensions soft, Actions no token budget, former doctypes soft, Recipes trigger validation, Orchestrator/Scaffold LLM audit; reborn_validation_config override changes validation outcome for next cycle); **SEC-02: validation config safety floors test** (config row below compiled-in floor rejected at save time; WebUI shows floor as disabled minimum); **SEC-04: rollback CAS test** (WHERE id=? AND failure_count=? prevents concurrent race); **SEC-05: score bounding test** (hard cap 100, rate limit 50/scope/hr, learned_llm flagged needs_review, purged on source component wipe).

steps.name: Phase 4 — Unified Extensions (Extensions + DocPlans dissected + Recipes, consumer_tags[])
steps.description: Merge Extensions + DocPlans + Recipes into reborn_extensions_unified with class enum (mcp_server/mcp_client/rusty/monty/llm/misc), class_codes 04-09, and consumer_tags[] (spec §3.9; GIN index; seed per class). DocPlans are DISSECTED, not migrated whole. Q15 RESOLVED — Recipes get their OWN class code 21 with a dedicated reborn_recipes table (solution-class with distinct schema: trigger + ordered steps + skill references + override_prompt_creation + prior_knowledge_content columns). reborn_extensions_unified class 09 (Misc) retains non-Recipe Misc extensions ONLY. **SCH-02 §6.1:** reborn_extensions_unified migration (V39) explicitly includes `prior_knowledge_content TEXT NULL` + `override_prompt_creation BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false` columns — Extensions are a solution class and need these columns for the Solution Override path (§3.13/§3.14). Steps: (4.1) V39 migration for reborn_extensions_unified (includes SCH-02 PKC/override columns) + V40 migration for reborn_recipes (class 21 — name/description/class_code/prompt_uid/intent_examples jsonb/consumer_tags[]/trigger jsonb/steps jsonb/status/prior_knowledge_content TEXT NULL/override_prompt_creation BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false/validation_status/validation_errors[]/review_feedback/review_attempts/rejected_at/queue_code/reward columns/source/lineage/content_hash/timestamps; RecipeLookup trait boundary preserved); (4.2) unified store + class adapters (mcp→ExtensionManifestV2, rusty→tool capability, monty→recipe/plan, llm→prompt-template); (4.3) dissect DocPlans + migrate DocType::Recipe MemoryDocs into reborn_recipes (class 21, NOT reborn_extensions_unified — step lists become steps jsonb, trigger becomes trigger jsonb, prior_knowledge_content + override_prompt_creation seeded from Recipe content) + migrate DocType::ToolSkill into reborn_extensions_unified with class=rusty; retire recipe_store.rs REST store + recipe_library.rs loop adapter in favor of unified store + reborn_recipes store; RecipeLookup trait now reads from reborn_recipes (class 21); (4.4) migrate existing extensions into reborn_extensions_unified. Verify: extension_contract.rs, installations_contract.rs, manifest_v2_contract.rs; test_plan_mode.py; extension consumer_tags[] per class; RECIPE CLASS 21 TEST (reborn_recipes has override_prompt_creation + prior_knowledge_content columns; RecipeLookup reads from reborn_recipes class 21; reborn_extensions_unified class 09 has NO Recipe rows; Recipe migration from DocType::Recipe populates steps/trigger/prior_knowledge_content/override_prompt_creation); **SCH-02 test: reborn_extensions_unified has prior_knowledge_content + override_prompt_creation columns** (solution-class Extension can use Solution Override path).

steps.name: Phase 5 — PlanA-memory connector + intent-driven retrieval + Rust formatting + former-doctype tables + de-chunk + DB-less fallback
steps.description: Make PlanA-memory the universal retrieval connector (DB = only source of truth). Two backends behind one RetrievalSource trait: PostgresSource (prod — reads reborn_skills/reborn_tools/reborn_extensions_unified/reborn_recipes (class 21, Q15)/reborn_orchestrators/reborn_scaffolds/reborn_monty_vm_settings/reborn_validation_config (Q14)/reborn_user_preferences (Q18 — ai_before_user key)/reborn_memory_*/reborn_actions/reborn_intent_inputs/reborn_specs/reborn_tool_skills/reborn_plans/reborn_summaries/reborn_docus/reborn_lessons/reborn_issues/reborn_notes/reborn_component_catalog (PERF-05 read model)) + RamSource (DB-less, compiled-in defaults incl. default orchestrator + scaffold + Monty VM settings + RAM thread memories + DB-LESS FALLBACK-CONTENT FILE loaded into in-memory index at startup per spec §3.4). **SEC-10 §6.1:** RamSource refuses non-local runtime profiles at startup (not local_dev/local_safe/local_yolo → clear error); fallback file integrity verified via content hash. fetch_for_consumer(consumer_tag) returns only rows that (a) carry requested consumer tag, (b) do NOT carry 05:validator, (c) are validation_status==Validated. **PERF-05 §6.1 — reborn_component_catalog read model:** materialized view (or UNION ALL view) across all component tables; RetrievalEngine queries by component_id + component_class_code in SINGLE query (no fan-out to 15+ tables); columns: id, scope, class_code, name, content/prior_knowledge_content, override_prompt_creation, validation_status, consumer_tags[], prompt_uid; filtered by validation_status='Validated' AND '05:validator' != ANY(consumer_tags) at query time (SEC-01); class-specific tables remain write path; catalog is read-only (refreshed via trigger or REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW); in DB-less mode RamSource builds in-memory catalog from fallback file. Step 5.1a: V41__reborn_monty_vm_settings.sql with **prior_knowledge_token_budget default 2000** (was 4000 — fixed) + q4_retention_days default 30 (Q7) + single row per scope tuple via upsert (Q8). Step 5.1a2: V42__reborn_user_preferences.sql (Q18 RESOLVED) — reborn_user_preferences table ((user_id, preference_key, preference_value, updated_at); composite unique (user_id, preference_key); **SEC-06 §6.1:** user-level scope NOT component-level — intentional, NOT a scope isolation violation; current keys: ai_before_user boolean default false; NOT exposed in Settings UI — runtime preferences; chat surface reads on turn start; toggle persists via PUT /api/chat/preferences/{key}; hidden/disabled in DB-less mode). Step 5.1b: DB-LESS FALLBACK-CONTENT FILE (Q17 RESOLVED — created at installation time when user selects not to install a DB, NOT exported from the DB which is impossible in DB-less; contains selected compiled-in entries — Tools→Scaffold→Orchestrator→Skills→Extensions Monty-first→Recipes→Specs/Lessons; Issues/Notes/Summaries excluded; ~256KB ~50,000 tokens ~5 original DocPlans; static during DB-less operation no learning; keyword-retrieval path pre-v4 preserved in retrieval_dbless.rs). Step 5.1c: MONTY VM LIFECYCLE MANAGER (spec §3.10) — kernel-owned. **PERF-16 §6.1 — drain + admission control:** on restart request kernel sets admission_paused flag (new turns queued not rejected with MontyRestartPending status); in-flight turns complete or timeout (max max_duration_secs) or abort with force=true+confirmation; once drained stop VM + apply new orchestrator/scaffold + restart; queued turns admitted in order; admission_paused cleared; status reported (running/draining/restarting/stopped/error); WebUI Monty VM tab shows restart status. Step 5.2: INTENT-DRIVEN RETRIEVAL — fetch_for_turn calls __resolve_intent__ then fetches matched components; **SEC-01 §6.1:** by-ID fetch path filters validation_status='Validated' AND '05:validator' != ANY(consumer_tags) — intent-resolved ID pointing to in-queue/rejected component silently dropped (orchestrator receives empty result → no-match path); __assemble_prior_knowledge__ Rust host function; token-budget limit from reborn_monty_vm_settings; ACTIONS (class_code 16) EXEMPT from prior_knowledge_token_budget truncation. Step 5.2a: PRIOR KNOWLEDGE FORMATTING (Q19 RESOLVED — "content is king" + Solution Override): delete Python formatters (format_docs/format_skills/append_system_append). One __assemble_prior_knowledge__ Rust host function + static class-code→label lookup table. **FMT-02 §6.1 — token-budget algorithm:** (1) fetch matched IDs, (2) query catalog single query, (3) sort by (class_code asc, prompt_uid asc), (4) Actions always included first (exempt), (5) Solution Override for override_prompt_creation:true, (6) Normal Assembly accumulates until budget exhausted, (7) components fully included or dropped (not truncated). Two assembly paths: (1) Solution Override — single matched solution-class component with override_prompt_creation: true → returns PKC/content as COMPLETE prompt text (no headers) + override_prompt_creation: true; orchestrator skips LLM call (Actions) or uses content as full prompt. (2) Normal Assembly — multiple components → assembles in (class_code asc, prompt_uid asc) order with ## Prior Knowledge header + per-item ### [{class_code}:{CLASS-LABEL}] {name} headers. **INT-01 §6.1 — disambiguation 30s timeout:** Rust-side timer, orchestrator not blocked; auto-select highest-scored candidate (or first by prompt_uid if equal); user can still click after timeout (increments score for future turns). **PERF-06 §6.1:** __assemble_prior_knowledge__ queries catalog with LIMIT 50 (bounded match set). **PERF-07 §6.1:** intent system returns by score DESC but __assemble_prior_knowledge__ re-sorts by (class_code asc, prompt_uid asc) for KV-cache discipline — intentional, score determines WHICH, class_code determines ORDER. DB columns prior_knowledge_content TEXT NULL + override_prompt_creation BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false (Actions default true) on solution-class tables only (Extensions, Plans, Recipes class 21, Actions). Q16 RESOLVED — pg_trgm extension installed at brassclaw installation time. Step 5.2b: Prompt composition — volatile memories as User message at N-1. Step 5.3: Former-doctype component tables (classes 12-20) V43-V50 migrations + document splitting into ≤5000-token rows with own prompt_uid + intent_examples. Step 5.4: FULLY REMOVE brassclaw_embeddings (Q3); chat memory as flat Note MemoryDocs (Q4); **SEC-11 §6.1:** Q4 wipe is single transaction (component + intent_inputs + reliability + provenance atomically deleted). Step 5.5: Delete chunk system; relocate extract_keywords/keyword_match_score/doc_type_weight to retrieval_dbless.rs (NOT deleted — PH-03 fix: extract_keywords is Rust function at retrieval.rs:80, used by "try it with AI" fallback throughout); delete ALL DocType variants. **SEC-04 §6.1:** rollback CAS protection (WHERE id=? AND failure_count=? prevents concurrent race). Verify: cargo test -p brassclaw_memory -p brassclaw_engine; __assemble_prior_knowledge__ both paths; PKC NULL fallback; non-solution classes do NOT have PKC/override columns; orchestrator has no format_docs/format_skills/append_system_append; **SEC-01: by-ID fetch drops in-queue/rejected components**; **PERF-05: reborn_component_catalog single-query fetch (no fan-out)**; **SEC-04: rollback CAS protection test**; **SEC-10: RamSource refuses non-local profiles**; **SEC-11: Q4 wipe single transaction test**; **PERF-16: Monty VM restart drain + admission control (admission_paused flag, in-flight turns complete/timeout, queued turns admitted in order, force=true aborts, status draining/restarting/running)**; **INT-01: disambiguation 30s timeout**; **PERF-06: LIMIT 50 bounded match set**; **PERF-07: re-sort by class_code asc, prompt_uid asc**; **FMT-02: token-budget algorithm (Actions exempt first, Solution Override, Normal Assembly accumulates, fully included or dropped)**; Monty VM restart test; Monty VM lifecycle kernel-owned; brassclaw_embeddings fully removed; chat memory as flat Note MemoryDocs; q4_retention_days from DB + DB-less default 30; reborn_monty_vm_settings single row per scope (upsert); reborn_user_preferences migration test (Q18 — composite unique, ai_before_user defaults false, chat surface reads on turn start, toggle persists, NOT in Settings UI, DB-less hides/disables); DB-less fallback file loads into RamSource (Q17 — created at installation time, static, keyword path); prior_knowledge_token_budget default 2000 (not 4000); all DocType variants removed; doc_type_weight/keyword_match_score/extract_keywords relocated to retrieval_dbless.rs.

steps.name: Phase 6 — Settings UI: 9-tab editor + Actions + intent examples + disambiguation UX + tag chips + 4-queue Validation Queue + Monty VM
steps.description: New Settings section: 9 tabs (Skills & Actions/Tools/Extensions/Orchestrator/Scaffold/Monty VM/Validation Queue/Reliability). Steps: WebUI v2 REST routes /api/settings/{skills,tools,extensions,actions,orchestrators,scaffolds,monty-vm} + POST /api/settings/monty-vm/restart (kernel-owned lifecycle manager) + GET /api/settings/monty-vm/status + EXTEND validation-queue endpoints (Q9): generalize recipe/tool_skill-specific routes to all ~20 class codes — GET /api/webchat/v2/validation-queue?q={auto|manual|revision|rejection} + GET .../count?q={queue} + PUT /api/webchat/v2/components/{class_code}/{component_id}/validate (pops 05:validator) + PUT .../reject + PUT .../send-to-revision + PUT .../re-review + DELETE .../{component_id} (Q4 wipe) + GET .../audit-status (LLM audit for class 10/50) + GET .../revision-history + intent system routes + PUT /api/chat/preferences/{key} (Q18 — ai_before_user persistence to reborn_user_preferences, NOT in Settings UI). Old recipe/tool_skill routes kept as aliases during migration.
